searchText: cc <@543900561460822016> We have a bug in calculating length of blob-type txs (we are not including size of actual blobs 😅 ). It is why we are sending huge `PooledTransactionsMessages`. And sizes in `NewPooledTransactionHashesMessage` are also affected. Preparing fix I made a tiny issue tracker to keep a log of things we find as well as fixes, especially so that we can include them in some test suite and prevent regressions: https://notes.ethereum.org/@parithosh/dencun-issue-tracker could you guys update the tracker with some info on what you found please? Devp2p test for blob txs is up on the latest commit in branch: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/759 At the moment it only tests that we get the broadcast of a new pooled blob tx (with the correct hash, type and size), and that the client responds with proper rlp serialization upon request of the tx. Run with: ```bash ./hive --client-file ./configs/4844.yaml -client go-ethereum --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-blobs/Request Blob Pooled Transactions" ``` Clients are failing due to several reasons but I will continue to debug tomorrow: - geth is giving the incorrect value in the size of the full blob tx when broadcasting the new pooled blob txs info - nethermind I haven't been able to pair with due to an differing fork id - ethjs I haven't been able to pair either because we are not receiving the eth68 support on connection Last two I suspect are config issues in hive, and I will try to fix tomorrow, but if there is anything obvious I might be missing please let me know 🙏

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Devp2p test for blob txs is up on the latest commit in branch: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/759
At the moment it only tests that we get the broadcast of a new pooled  blob tx (with the correct hash, type and size), and that the client responds with proper rlp serialization upon request of the tx.
Run with:
```bash
./hive --client-file ./configs/4844.yaml -client go-ethereum --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-blobs/Request Blob Pooled Transactions"
```
Clients are failing due to several reasons but I will continue to debug tomorrow:
- geth is giving the incorrect value in the size of the full blob tx when broadcasting the new pooled blob txs info
- nethermind I haven't been able to pair with due to an differing fork id
- ethjs I haven't been able to pair either because we are not receiving the eth68 support on connection

Last two I suspect are config issues in hive, and I will try to fix tomorrow, but if there is anything obvious I might be missing please let me know 🙏
